svg.title: Periodic table of the elements
svg.desc: Periodic table with IUPAC group numbers 1 to 18 and the older U.S. A and B numbers. Each cell shows the atomic number, symbol, and an abridged atomic mass. Alkali metals are purple, alkaline earth metals green, other metals teal, metalloids gold, nonmetals tan, halogens red, and noble gases dark blue. The lanthanides and actinides are in two rows below.
